answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil rings: full rewards need 25 distinct, unrelated counterparties over 10 epochs. A ring of 1,000 fakes finds no haven, since trades funnelling through one jetty — one funding wallet — count as one counterparty. Each fake needs 25 relationships at $40 escrow each, so 1,000 fakes cost $1,000,000, while their chatter is only a whisper on the public graph. An honest agent pays one $40 escrow and keeps full rewards.
